جَابِهٌ , applied to a gazelle, (JK,) or to a bird or a wild animal, (K,) That meets one with its face or forehead; and such is of evil omen: (K:) contr. of قَعِيدٌ. (JK.) ―
-b2- Coming to water: so in a saying cited and explained in art. اذن, conj. 2. (IAar, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
